name: Noona
tagline: Available appointments and bookings on Noona
description: Find businesses on Noona, check services and prices, and search for available appointments without signing in. Sign in with an SMS code to book, view your appointments or cancel them.
examples: Find a barber in Hafnarfjörður with an available appointment on Friday.
Are there any haircut appointments on Saturday morning?
auth: none for search/services/slots; phone (SMS code) for bookings

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Search businesses by text, location, type; public

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Services at a business with duration and starting price; public

tools.name: list_slots
tools.description: Open time slots for a business by service/employee, up to 31 days; public

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: One booking in full by event id

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: API reachability, login and token checks

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Book an appointment; preview unless confirm=true

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel a booking; confirmEventId must repeat eventId

envVars.name: NOONA_CC
envVars.description: Default phone country code for login (default 354)

envVars.name: NOONA_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES
envVars.description: Set to 1 to expose create_booking and cancel_booking over MCP

is.tagline: Lausir tímar og bókanir á Noona
is.description: Finndu fyrirtæki á Noona, skoðaðu þjónustu og verð og leitaðu að lausum tímum án innskráningar. Skráðu þig inn með SMS-kóða til að bóka tíma, skoða bókanirnar þínar eða afbóka.
examples: Finndu rakara í Hafnarfirði með lausan tíma á föstudaginn.
Eru lausir tímar í klippingu á laugardagsmorgun?
